## Behavior

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. Link the relevant upstream contract or explain why it is a .NET-specific change.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full verification was run, or the reason it is unnecessary is stated.

## Documentation and licensing
